title_draft: Zad Archery Beginner Guide: What the Main Systems Do
quick_answer_draft: Zad Archery is a short incremental RPG built around clearing waves, collecting loot, then unlocking systems such as the skill tree, jobs, crafting, mining, Shaping, Mastery and Guardian Perks. The safest beginner advice from public evidence is to learn each system as it unlocks rather than follow an unverified 'best build'.

sections.h2: What kind of game is Zad Archery?

claims.text: The core loop is clearing target-like enemies, taking loot and reinvesting into upgrades and skills.
Steam tags the game as Incremental, Idler, Loot, Platformer, Roguelite, RPG, Strategy, Crafting and Mining.
The live Steam description explicitly lists a large Skill Tree, five Archer Jobs, loot, skills, crafting and mining.
The same live description names Shaping, Masteries and Guardian Perks as later systems.
Developer/demo material additionally describes alchemy and gathering/herbing.
claims.caveat: Verify exact full-release UI/availability before detailed instructions.

sections.h2: How long should a first run take?

claims.text: The developer said the game is designed around five hours, with build and loot differences affecting duration.
Launch-day Reddit reports cluster around roughly four to five and a half hours.

media_slots.capture_target: UI showing the main progression system tabs

faq.q: How many jobs are in Zad Archery?
faq.a: The official Steam description says there are five Archer Jobs.

faq.q: Is Zad Archery an idle game?
faq.a: Steam lists it as both Incremental and Idler, but the public descriptions also emphasize active wave clearing and build progression.
